newsitem.title: USA: BASF unit to close U.S. magnetics facility.
newsitem.headline: BASF unit to close U.S. magnetics facility.

text.p: BASF Corp said Wednesday it will close BASF Magnetics Corp, based in Bedford, Massachusettes, offering severance packages to 115 employees, who are mainly involved in sales and marketing.
The company said that at year-end it will discontinue handling the magnetic tape business in the United States and Canada for BASF Magnetics GmbH, headquartered in Ludwigshafen, Germany.

BASF Corp, a unit of BASF AG, said that BASF Magnetics GmbH will assume direct responsibility through independent distributors for the professional duplicator, audio/video studio and data media businesses in the U.S. and Canada.
In Canada, about 13 affected employees in similar functions in Toronto, Ontario, will be offered severance packages, as well.
